subject: GSPC board totals (councilof.ai)

states.FRESH: a readback succeeded and matches every asserted value
states.STALE: a readback succeeded and no longer matches an asserted value (the claim drifted from its source)
states.SUPERSEDED: a dated record in SUPERSEDED.jsonl replaces this claim; read that record instead
states.WITHDRAWN: a dated record in SUPERSEDED.jsonl withdraws this claim; do not repeat it as current
states.UNVERIFIABLE: the readback could not be taken (fetch failed or source unreadable). Never render this as STALE, 0 or null

supersession_worked_example: C-2026-0925-01 (did.json custody): a separated-custody claim was withdrawn with dated provenance and 5 OSAIA threads (#18 #27 #37 #38 #66) held until corrected; see README.md and SUPERSEDED.jsonl
note: Measurement, never certification. Counts are pointers with an as_of, not permanent totals. Corrections supersede with dated provenance; this envelope claims no storage property of any ledger.
